copy.headline: Texas power grid CEO secures multimillion-dollar contract extension, angering Dan Patrick
copy.caption: The ERCOT CEO’s extension deal was on hold for months after the lieutenant governor criticized the payouts. It was finalized weeks after Patrick lost reelection.
